title: Far-right politician Éric Zemmour joins 2027 French presidential race
summary: French far-right politician Éric Zemmour said on Friday that he would run in next year's presidential election, joining far-right candidate Marine Le Pen, who was runner-up to President Emmanuel Macron in the last two elections.
